correctness.rationale: The harmonic Bergman basis yields T_{z²+bz}=U²+bU+(1/6)e_1 tensor e_-1, where U is invertible bilateral weighted shift with spectrum unit circle. Rank-one resolvent determinant m(lambda) gives the single mixed-root outlier alpha=-3b/7, beta=-4b/7 only for 7/4<|b|<7/3 and derivative m’=686/b², ensuring simplicity. Explicit bilateral resolvent expansions determine both rank-one projection vectors; their squared norm is 2/|alpha-beta|² times [1/(1-|alpha|²)²+(-log(1-q)-q)/q]. Divide by |m’| to yield norm formula. Endpoint expansions give log factor 1/7 and quadratic factor 7/36. Recomputed 1,000-term norm sums at three interior b values; no inference about outside or at collision endpoints.
residual_risks: The exact norm is confined to quadratic symbol and open outlier interval; sampled finite sections cannot establish completeness of the essential-spectrum argument.
